items.title: Blue Upward Arrow Road Sign
items.alt: White upward arrow on a blue rectangular road sign mounted on a short metal post.
items.description: A double white border frames the arrow, with two bolts securing the blue plate to its silver post.

items.title: Wooden Up Sign beside Three Steps
items.alt: Wooden arrow sign reading UP beside three wooden steps, stones and green plants.
items.description: Wood grain and small metal fasteners give the sign and steps a rustic appearance. The painted white arrow points straight upward.

items.title: Pressing the Elevator Up Button
items.alt: Hand pressing an illuminated yellow up button on a silver elevator call panel.
items.description: The upper triangle glows yellow above an unlit downward triangle. Rounded corners and two screws finish the narrow metal panel.

items.title: Laptop Uploading to a Blue Cloud
items.alt: Large blue arrow rises from an open laptop toward a rounded blue cloud.
items.description: The upload arrow overlaps the laptop screen and cloud. Pale highlights give the simple blue shapes a glossy finish.

items.title: Amber Double Up Chevron
items.alt: Two amber upward chevrons with thick navy outlines and a white gap between them.
items.description: The stacked angular marks form a compact direction symbol. Dark edging separates each amber face from the open space around it.

items.title: Curving Road Arrow to a Red Flag
items.alt: Dark curved road with a dashed white center line rises to an arrowhead and red flag.
items.description: The wide road sweeps upward from the lower left. A small flag marks the pointed destination at the top.

items.title: Building an Up Arrow with Toy Blocks
items.alt: Hand places a red arrowhead on a tower of blue, green, yellow, orange and red blocks.
items.description: The bright blocks form a rising stack capped by a triangular red point. A blue sleeve enters beside the hand placing the top piece.

items.title: Hand-Drawn Red Up Arrow
items.alt: Textured red upward arrow with a black outline and the word UP below.
items.description: Short accent strokes emphasize the arrow's direction. The uneven red fill and dark edging give the symbol a drawn appearance.

items.title: Folded Red Ribbon Up Arrow
items.alt: Glossy red ribbon twists into an upward arrow with a notched lower tail.
items.description: Folded bands cross the arrow's stem, with bright highlights along their edges. The pointed top and cut ribbon tail keep the silhouette clear.

items.title: Chalkboard Up Arrow on an Easel
items.alt: Small wooden easel supports a black chalkboard with a white arrow and UP lettering.
items.description: Chalk-like texture softens the white marks against the dark board. The wooden frame rests on two angled easel legs.

items.title: Girl in Yellow Pointing Up
items.alt: Curly-haired cartoon girl in a yellow dress points toward a small yellow arrow above her finger.
items.description: A yellow headband matches her dress, while blue stripes repeat on her shirt and socks. Her raised arm and upward gaze reinforce the direction.

items.title: Boy in a Teal Hoodie Pointing Up
items.alt: Brown-haired cartoon boy in a teal hoodie and jeans points toward a blue upward arrow.
items.description: The boy tilts his face toward the arrow, with one arm stretched diagonally above his shoulder. White-trimmed sneakers complete the standing pose.

items.title: Teacher Holding an Up Arrow Card
items.alt: Silver-haired woman with glasses raises one finger while holding a card with a blue arrow and UP.
items.description: The teacher wears a blue cardigan over a white top. Her raised finger repeats the direction printed on the white teaching card.

items.title: Child with a Backpack Climbing Steps
items.alt: Red-haired cartoon child with an orange backpack climbs gray steps beside a green arrow.
items.description: A green shirt and sneakers contrast with blue trousers and the orange backpack. The side view shows one foot advancing onto a higher step.

items.title: Woman Walking Up a Staircase
items.alt: Woman in a burgundy top and navy trousers walks up gray stairs beside a blue arrow.
items.description: Her dark ponytail follows the upward stride. Blue heels and a diagonal arrow add direction to the clean side-view composition.

items.title: Wheelchair User Ascending a Ramp
items.alt: Cartoon wheelchair user in a blue jacket moves up a gray ramp beside a blue arrow.
items.description: The sloping ramp includes a silver handrail. A side view shows the large rear wheel, small front caster and the rider facing uphill.

items.title: Children Reaching Up Together
items.alt: Two smiling cartoon children reach both arms toward a blue upward arrow.
items.description: One child wears a coral dress and twin braids; the other has blond hair and purple overalls. Their open hands stretch toward the arrow between them.

items.title: Man Looking toward an Up Arrow
items.alt: Bearded man in a denim shirt and tan trousers looks up at a large blue arrow.
items.description: The relaxed standing figure keeps both hands in his pockets. His tilted head directs attention to the bold arrow above his shoulder.

items.title: Rabbit Pointing toward a Green Arrow
items.alt: Gray cartoon rabbit with pink ears and a green scarf points toward a green upward arrow.
items.description: The rabbit smiles beneath its long ears, holding one paw close to its chest. Small green marks emphasize the arrow above the pointing paw.

items.title: Owl Teaching the Up Direction
items.alt: Brown owl in round glasses and a navy vest uses a pointer beside a green arrow on an easel.
items.description: A red tie and gold vest buttons dress the owl as a cartoon teacher. Its wooden pointer rests against the arrow on the cream board.

items.title: Red Balloon Rising above a Hand
items.alt: Glossy red-orange balloon floats above a blue-cuffed hand beside a dotted blue up arrow.
items.description: A loose blue string curls between the balloon and hand. The small dotted arrow echoes the balloon's upward movement.

items.title: Kite Climbing into the Wind
items.alt: Red, yellow, blue and green diamond kite rises above two hands holding its line and reel.
items.description: A long tail of colored ties hangs from the kite. The curved blue arrow follows its ascent, while the separate hands manage the taut string below.

items.title: Cartoon Rocket Launching Upward
items.alt: Red-and-white rocket with a blue window rises on an orange flame beside a green arrow.
items.description: Rounded smoke clouds collect below the rocket's small launch base. Red fins and nose cone frame the white body in this playful space illustration.

items.title: Paper Airplane on an Ascending Path
items.alt: Blue-and-white paper airplane follows a curved dotted path toward the upper right.
items.description: The folded plane sits above the looping blue trail. A small arrowhead at the end of the dashed line marks its climbing route.

items.title: Blue Bird Taking Flight
items.alt: Blue songbird spreads its wings above a leafy twig beside a curved upward arrow.
items.description: A white breast and yellow beak brighten the small bird. The rising arrow follows the lift from the twig into open space.

items.title: Hot-Air Balloon Rising with a Passenger
items.alt: Red, white and blue hot-air balloon carries a small passenger above a blue up arrow.
items.description: The striped balloon tapers toward suspension ropes and a wicker basket. A child's face peeks over the basket rim.

items.title: Bubbles Floating Up from a Wand
items.alt: Hand holds a blue bubble wand beneath rising rainbow-tinted bubbles and a blue arrow.
items.description: Large and small bubbles form a loose vertical trail above the ring. The curved arrow runs alongside them to show their upward movement.

items.title: Steam Rising from a Striped Mug
items.alt: Cream mug with blue bands and dark drink gives off curls of steam beside a green arrow.
items.description: The rounded handle sits on the left of the cup. Gray steam rises above the rim while the broad arrow emphasizes the same upward direction.

items.title: Sunflower Growing toward the Sun
items.alt: Potted sunflower reaches upward beside a green arrow and a small smiling sun.
items.description: Broad leaves flank the tall stem above a terracotta pot. The yellow bloom and sun create two bright points at the top of the drawing.

items.title: Water Jet Rising from a Garden Fountain
items.alt: Pale stone garden fountain sends water upward beside a blue arrow and green plants.
items.description: The central jet curves outward into falling streams above the basin. Low leafy plants surround the fountain's base.

items.title: Hands Holding Colorful Up Letters
items.alt: Two blue-cuffed hands hold blue U and red P letters below a yellow upward arrow.
items.description: The large rounded letters overlap at their inner edges. Bright yellow rays emphasize the tall arrow rising behind them.

items.title: Way Up Hiking Signpost
items.alt: Wooden WAY UP sign with an upward arrow stands beside a hiking boot, stones and grass.
items.description: The orange-laced boot leans against the post beneath the horizontal sign. Wood grain and small fasteners add detail to the outdoor marker.

items.title: Hanging Upstairs Sign
items.alt: Cream hanging sign shows a stair-climbing figure, blue up arrow and the word UPSTAIRS.
items.description: Two short chains suspend the black-edged sign from a wall bracket. The stair pictogram sits to the left of the arrow.

items.title: This Way Up Shipping Box
items.alt: Sealed brown cardboard box bears two upward arrows and THIS WAY UP handling text.
items.description: A strip of tan tape crosses the top seam. The front panel's dark arrows and underlined base indicate the box's upright orientation.

items.title: Boy Pointing beneath an Up Speech Bubble
items.alt: Cartoon boy in a blue shirt points at an UP speech bubble below a yellow arrow.
items.description: The smiling child looks toward his raised finger. Red-and-white sneakers add a small color accent beneath his navy trousers.

items.title: Level Up Star Badge
items.alt: Blue circular badge with a green upward arrow, gold star and LEVEL UP ribbon.
items.description: The arrow rises through the center toward a faceted star. A navy-edged blue ribbon carries the white lettering across the badge's lower edge.

items.title: Boy Holding a Heads Up Reminder
items.alt: Smiling boy in a blue hoodie points toward a HEADS UP sign with a blue arrow.
items.description: The small sign sits on a wooden handle beside the child's face. His upward gaze follows the printed arrow and stacked reminder text.

items.title: Boy Standing Up from a Chair
items.alt: Cartoon boy in a blue hoodie stands beside a classroom chair and a green STAND UP marker.
items.description: His hands hang beside his trousers as he rises in front of the wooden seat. The green arrow and outlined label clarify the action.

items.title: Squirrel Climbing to a Climb Up Sign
items.alt: Orange-brown squirrel climbs a wooden ladder beside a CLIMB UP sign and green arrow.
items.description: Its large curled tail balances the climbing pose. The ladder leans against the signpost above a small patch of grass.

items.title: Up and Away Cartoon Airplane
items.alt: Red cartoon airplane climbs above UP AND AWAY lettering and a curved yellow arrow.
items.description: A smiling pilot with goggles sits in the blue cockpit. The yellow arrow curves toward the aircraft, linking the stacked words to the climbing flight.

items.title: Pointing Up Hand Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white hand outline with its index finger pointing straight upward.
items.description: Fine creases mark the raised finger, curled knuckles and palm. The wrist ends in a clean curved edge below the hand.

items.title: Child Climbing Steps Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white cartoon child climbs three steps toward a large upward arrow.
items.description: The side-view child lifts one knee above the lower step. Open white shapes and clear dark contours distinguish the figure from the stair blocks.

items.title: Elevator and Up Arrow Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white closed elevator doors with an up arrow above and call buttons beside them.
items.description: A double-line frame surrounds the two elevator panels. The small button plate repeats the up and down direction symbols.

items.title: Rising Balloon Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white balloon with a curling string and an upward arrow beside it.
items.description: Two small highlight shapes sit inside the balloon's upper curve. Short motion strokes reinforce its rise.

items.title: Up Lettering with Stair Arrow Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white UP lettering beside a staircase-shaped arrow climbing to the right.
items.description: The hollow block letters sit above the lower stair edges. A broad arrowhead finishes the rising stepped path.

items.title: Cloud Upload Laptop Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white laptop beneath a cloud with a tall upward upload arrow.
items.description: The arrow passes from the open screen toward the cloud. Bold contours keep the cloud, keyboard base and arrow easy to separate.

items.title: Rising Blue Bar Chart
items.alt: Three blue bars increase in height beneath a curved green upward arrow.
items.description: The columns share a baseline but step from short to tall. Dark blue side faces give them a simple dimensional appearance.

items.title: Open Book with an Upward Arrow
items.alt: Two blue-cuffed hands hold an open blue book as a yellow arrow rises between its pages.
items.description: Cream page edges fan outward above the covers. The bright arrow emerges near the center fold without covering the hands.

items.title: Mountain Trail Leading Up to a Flag
items.alt: Winding tan trail climbs a green and gray mountain toward a red summit flag beside a blue arrow.
items.description: Small trees flank the lower slope. The broad blue arrow follows the mountain's left side while the narrow path zigzags toward the peak.

items.title: Hands Holding an Up Direction Card
items.alt: Two hands hold a blue-bordered white card showing UP and a blue upward arrow.
items.description: The rectangular teaching card fills the center between two blue cuffs. Dark lettering above the arrow keeps the word and direction together.
